market_summary: FX and index markets (EURUSD, GBPUSD, US100) are consolidating inside session Value Areas around flat VWAPs during late London session, lacking breakout volume or directional edge. BTCUSD shows a clean trend expansion breakdown below VAL and the lower ATR channel with aligned bearish CVD.

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (1.10786 - 1.10998) and below POC (1.10943). CVD is BULLISH (+4543) but short-term slope is negative (-562). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is holding above VWAP (1.10864) and EMA50 (1.10897), but consolidating mid-channel between EMA20 and +2 ATR. RVOL is modest at 1.149 without a yellow spike. Rejection near S/R (1.11007) and Session High (1.11027). GEX is null. Mid-range chop inside VA calls for HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish / price holding above VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection / upper range rejection below Session High

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (1.32605 - 1.32797) and below POC (1.32738). CVD is BEARISH (-3697) with declining slope (-1145). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is hugging VWAP (1.32672) and EMA50 (1.32700) with flat trajectory. ATR bands are contracting and candles are stuck at mid-channel. RVOL is low at 0.679. Far from Session High (1.32809) and Session Low (1.32500). GEX is null. Lack of directional expansion warrants HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral / price oscillating tightly around VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (28086.57 - 28185.57) and below VWAP (28132.58) and EMA50 (28160.16), hovering around POC (28121.92). CVD is BEARISH (-3.41) with negative slope (-0.05). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is positioned in the lower half of the ATR channel approaching S/R support at 28100.36 and 28083.64. RVOL is 0.81 (US100 tick volume caveat applies, but no strong impulse). GEX is null. Inside VA chop and resting near immediate support mandates HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / price below declining VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (73341.40) and far below POC (73531.03) in an expanding low-volume node. CVD is BEARISH (-0.05) with negative slope (-0.01), agreeing with the strong downtrend. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is trading substantially below both VWAP (73551.01) and EMA50 (73511.87). Volatility is expanding with ATR expanding vs 20-bar average and price breaking below -2 ATR band (72937.79). RVOL is elevated at 1.447. Retesting and breaking through Session Low (72670.40). GEX is null. Bearish continuation momentum is strong.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / strong breakdown below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance / breakdown below Session Low and lower ATR band
